description_ar: أسئلة مباشرة حول تحويل الجمل والأسئلة والأوامر إلى كلام منقول

questions.question_en: "I am tired," she said. → She said she ___ tired.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: was. Backshift: am → was.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: was. تراجع الزمن: am ← was.
questions.memorization_note: تراجع زمن خطوة: $\text{present simple} \rightarrow \text{past simple}$ ، $\text{present perfect/past simple} \rightarrow \text{past perfect}$ ، $\text{will} \rightarrow \text{would}$ ، $\text{can} \rightarrow \text{could}$ ، $\text{may} \rightarrow \text{might}$ ، $\text{must} \rightarrow \text{had to}$.

questions.question_en: "I will come," he said. → He said he ___ come.
questions.memorization_note: تراجع زمن خطوة: $\text{present simple} \rightarrow \text{past simple}$ ، $\text{present perfect/past simple} \rightarrow \text{past perfect}$ ، $\text{will} \rightarrow \text{would}$ ، $\text{can} \rightarrow \text{could}$ ، $\text{may} \rightarrow \text{might}$ ، $\text{must} \rightarrow \text{had to}$.

questions.question_en: "I have finished," she said. → She said she ___ finished.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: had. present perfect → past perfect.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: had. المضارع التام ← الماضي التام had.
questions.memorization_note: تراجع زمن خطوة: $\text{present simple} \rightarrow \text{past simple}$ ، $\text{present perfect/past simple} \rightarrow \text{past perfect}$ ، $\text{will} \rightarrow \text{would}$ ، $\text{can} \rightarrow \text{could}$ ، $\text{may} \rightarrow \text{might}$ ، $\text{must} \rightarrow \text{had to}$.

questions.question_en: "Where do you live?" → He asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: lived. Normal order and backshift: lived.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: lived. ترتيب عادي مع تراجع الزمن: lived.
questions.memorization_note: الأسئلة المنقولة بترتيب عادي: $\text{asked} + \text{wh-word} + S + V$ ، و $\text{asked if/whether} + S + V$.

questions.question_en: "Close the door," she said. → She told me ___ the door.
questions.question_ar: "أغلق الباب" قالت. ← قالت لي أن ____ الباب.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: to close. Command → told + object + to + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: to close. أمر ← told + مفعول + to + V1.
questions.memorization_note: الأوامر: $\text{told/asked} + \text{object} + \text{to} + V_1$ ، والنهي: $\text{told} + \text{object} + \text{not to} + V_1$ ، و $\text{tell} + \text{شخص}$ ، $\text{say} + (that)$ ، $\text{suggest} + V\text{-ing}$.

questions.question_en: "Don't touch it," he said. → He told me ___ it.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: not to touch. Negative command → not to + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: not to touch. نهي ← not to + V1.
questions.memorization_note: الأوامر: $\text{told/asked} + \text{object} + \text{to} + V_1$ ، والنهي: $\text{told} + \text{object} + \text{not to} + V_1$ ، و $\text{tell} + \text{شخص}$ ، $\text{say} + (that)$ ، $\text{suggest} + V\text{-ing}$.

questions.question_en: "I can swim," he said. → He said he ___ swim.
questions.memorization_note: تراجع زمن خطوة: $\text{present simple} \rightarrow \text{past simple}$ ، $\text{present perfect/past simple} \rightarrow \text{past perfect}$ ، $\text{will} \rightarrow \text{would}$ ، $\text{can} \rightarrow \text{could}$ ، $\text{may} \rightarrow \text{might}$ ، $\text{must} \rightarrow \text{had to}$.

questions.question_en: "Are you ready?" → She asked if I ___ ready.
questions.question_ar: "هل أنت جاهز؟" ← سألت إن كنت ____ جاهزاً.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: was. Yes/no question: if + backshift (am → was).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: was. سؤال نعم/لا: if + تراجع الزمن was.
questions.memorization_note: الأسئلة المنقولة بترتيب عادي: $\text{asked} + \text{wh-word} + S + V$ ، و $\text{asked if/whether} + S + V$.

questions.question_en: "I saw him yesterday." → He said he had seen him ___.
questions.question_ar: "رأيته أمس" ← قال إنه كان قد رآه ____.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: the day before. yesterday → the day before.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: the day before. yesterday ← the day before.
questions.memorization_note: الزمان والمكان: $\text{now} \rightarrow \text{then}$ ، $\text{yesterday} \rightarrow \text{the day before}$ ، $\text{tomorrow} \rightarrow \text{the next day}$ ، $\text{next week} \rightarrow \text{the following week}$ ، $\text{here} \rightarrow \text{there}$.

questions.question_en: "I'm working here now." → She said she was working there ___.
questions.question_ar: "أعمل هنا الآن" ← قالت إنها كانت تعمل هناك ____.
questions.memorization_note: الزمان والمكان: $\text{now} \rightarrow \text{then}$ ، $\text{yesterday} \rightarrow \text{the day before}$ ، $\text{tomorrow} \rightarrow \text{the next day}$ ، $\text{next week} \rightarrow \text{the following week}$ ، $\text{here} \rightarrow \text{there}$.

questions.question_en: "I'll call you tomorrow." → He said he would call me ___.
questions.question_ar: "سأتصل بك غداً" ← قال إنه سيتصل بي ____.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: the next day. tomorrow → the next day.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: the next day. tomorrow ← the next day.
questions.memorization_note: الزمان والمكان: $\text{now} \rightarrow \text{then}$ ، $\text{yesterday} \rightarrow \text{the day before}$ ، $\text{tomorrow} \rightarrow \text{the next day}$ ، $\text{next week} \rightarrow \text{the following week}$ ، $\text{here} \rightarrow \text{there}$.

questions.question_en: She ___ me that she was busy.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: told. tell + person + that.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: told. tell + شخص + that.
questions.memorization_note: الأوامر: $\text{told/asked} + \text{object} + \text{to} + V_1$ ، والنهي: $\text{told} + \text{object} + \text{not to} + V_1$ ، و $\text{tell} + \text{شخص}$ ، $\text{say} + (that)$ ، $\text{suggest} + V\text{-ing}$.

questions.question_en: "What time is it?" → He asked me what time ___.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: it was. No inversion in reported questions; backshift: it was.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: it was. بدون قلب مع تراجع الزمن: it was.
questions.memorization_note: الأسئلة المنقولة بترتيب عادي: $\text{asked} + \text{wh-word} + S + V$ ، و $\text{asked if/whether} + S + V$.

questions.question_en: "Let's go to the beach." → He suggested ___ to the beach.
questions.question_ar: "هيا نذهب إلى الشاطئ" ← اقترح ____ إلى الشاطئ.
questions.memorization_note: الأوامر: $\text{told/asked} + \text{object} + \text{to} + V_1$ ، والنهي: $\text{told} + \text{object} + \text{not to} + V_1$ ، و $\text{tell} + \text{شخص}$ ، $\text{say} + (that)$ ، $\text{suggest} + V\text{-ing}$.

questions.question_en: "I must go." → He said he ___ go.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: had to. must → had to.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: had to. must ← had to.
questions.memorization_note: تراجع زمن خطوة: $\text{present simple} \rightarrow \text{past simple}$ ، $\text{present perfect/past simple} \rightarrow \text{past perfect}$ ، $\text{will} \rightarrow \text{would}$ ، $\text{can} \rightarrow \text{could}$ ، $\text{may} \rightarrow \text{might}$ ، $\text{must} \rightarrow \text{had to}$.
